title: Ideal Carrier Thread count using Java Virtual Threads in Kubernetes

title: Refactoring a Spring MVC application using Spring Cloud API Gate

I've continued serving JSPs to the client side using the API Gateway. What I want to know is if there are any draw backs to doing this? So, I'm not sure if sending JSP across an API Gateway is considered a bad practice or if there are problems this could create later on. Is sending JSP across an API Gateway considered a bad practice in software development. If so, why?
